proposal.reason: Primary change is copy-engine behavior: CE/ltOki ring isolation, CE stream hinting/ring mapping, reserved-stream submission policy, OKI QP queue-id allocation, and CE reduction DMA tail/bounds handling to avoid mixed CE+ltOki hangs. transport is additionally needed because peer capability exchange now carries an OKI feature bitmap (peerInfo.okiEnable) with cross-rank agreement checks in transport initialization, changing connection-time feature negotiation semantics.
